name: Lakshadweep
summary: India's smallest Union Territory (32 sq km), an archipelago of 36 coral atolls and submerged sand banks in the Arabian Sea. Renowned for pristine turquoise lagoons, coconut cultivation, and tuna fishing.
monuments: Ujra Mosque (Kavaratti), Minicoy Island Lighthouse (est. 1885 by British)
nationalParks: Pitti Bird Sanctuary (Pakshipitti - breeding ground for pelagic birds)
schemes: Lakshadweep Tourism Development Initiatives, Desalination Water Mission

mcqs.qHi: लक्षद्वीप का सबसे दक्षिणी मिनिकॉय द्वीप मुख्य लक्षद्वीप द्वीपसमूह से किस जलडमरूमध्य द्वारा अलग होता है?
mcqs.questionTextHi: लक्षद्वीप का सबसे दक्षिणी मिनिकॉय द्वीप मुख्य लक्षद्वीप द्वीपसमूह से किस जलडमरूमध्य द्वारा अलग होता है?
mcqs.exp: The 9 Degree Channel separates Minicoy Island from the northern Amindivi and Laccadive groups of islands (8 Degree Channel separates Minicoy from Maldives).
mcqs.explanation: The 9 Degree Channel separates Minicoy Island from the northern Amindivi and Laccadive groups of islands (8 Degree Channel separates Minicoy from Maldives).
mcqs.expHi: 9 डिग्री चैनल मिनिकॉय द्वीप को कल्पेनी और सुहेली पार से अलग करता है, जबकि 8 डिग्री चैनल मिनिकॉय को मालदीव से अलग करता है।
mcqs.explanationHi: 9 डिग्री चैनल मिनिकॉय द्वीप को कल्पेनी और सुहेली पार से अलग करता है, जबकि 8 डिग्री चैनल मिनिकॉय को मालदीव से अलग करता है।
mcqs.hint: Reflect upon the geographic, political, and cultural heritage of Lakshadweep.
mcqs.hintHi: 8 डिग्री चैनल इसे मालदीव से अलग करता है और यह चैनल लक्षद्वीप के मुख्य समूह से।

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Lakshadweep.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Kavaratti. Lakshadweep covers a geographic area of 32 sq km across 1 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Nil (no inland rivers or streams).

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: India's smallest Union Territory (32 sq km), an archipelago of 36 coral atolls and submerged sand banks in the Arabian Sea. Renowned for pristine turquoise lagoons, coconut cultivation, and tuna fishing.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Lakshadweep.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Lakshadweep was formally instituted on 1 November 1956. Official language(s): Malayalam, English, Mahl (in Minicoy).

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Lava dance (Minicoy), Kolkali, Parichakali.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Eid-ul-Fitr, Bakrid, Milad-un-Nabi.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Lakshadweep.

facts.title: Administrator & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Administrator is Praful Patel.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Kerala High Court (Kochi).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Butterfly fish | State Bird: Brown noddy | State Flower: Nil | State Tree: Breadfruit.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Lakshadweep.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Phosphate deposits, Coral limestone.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Lakshadweep plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Lakshadweep.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Ujra Mosque (Kavaratti), Minicoy Island Lighthouse (est. 1885 by British).

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Pitti Bird Sanctuary (Pakshipitti - breeding ground for pelagic birds).
